title: cjk@1: the shared table of Chinese characters
description: cjk/characters.jsonl: every character that hanzi (Chinese), kanji (Japanese) or hanja (Korean) teaches, once, with what the traditions share. Readings and meanings live with each language, in cjk-readings@1 files; which traditions use a character follows from those.
